message.content:
You can get **free SiriusXM satellite radio** only through **promotional trials or partner offers**, not as a permanent free service.[3][6][4]

- SiriusXM currently advertises a **3-month free trial** with **no credit card required** on its trial-eligibility page.[6]
- SiriusXM also shows a **free listen event** page, but the listed event there has **ended**; the page now points to a paid **$1 for your first 3 months** offer that **requires a credit card**.[3]
- Some partner promotions may offer free access, such as a **3-month trial for Navy Federal Credit Union members** with **no credit card required**.[4]
- T-Mobile also offers **6 months of SiriusXM Streaming Platinum** for eligible customers, but that is a **streaming app offer**, not necessarily satellite-in-car radio.[5]

If you want, I can help you find the **best currently available free SiriusXM option** based on whether you want **in-car satellite**, **app streaming**, or **a no-credit-card trial**.
